_comment: Ground-truth expected structured intent for each prompt. 'tickers' is compared as a set (order-insensitive). If 'timeframe_pattern' is null, that field is not graded (used for the deliberately-ambiguous / needs-clarification cases). 'metric' and 'analysis_type' are null (not graded) whenever needs_clarification is expected to be true, since a request that needs clarification never reaches those fields meaningfully. Case #23 is a deliberate known-limitation case (see README) included specifically so this eval set is not tuned to trivially pass -- it demonstrates the mock planner's fixed company-name dictionary missing an uncommon name, which a real LLM provider would not be expected to miss.
reference_date_note: Timeframe patterns like 'last_6_months' resolve relative to the date the eval is run; the eval grades the *pattern string*, not resolved calendar dates, so results are stable across days.

cases.prompt: Compare Apple and Microsoft over the last 6 months.
Show me Tesla's performance during 2025.
Compare AAPL, MSFT and NVDA over the past 6 months.
Plot normalized returns for Tesla and Apple since January 2024.
How has Amazon done over the last year?
Compare Netflix and Meta over the last 3 months.
Show NVDA year to date.
Compare Google and Amazon cumulative returns since 2023-01-01.
What has Intel's stock done in 2024?
Compare AMD vs NVDA over the last 2 years.
Plot Berkshire Hathaway's performance since March 2022.
Compare Apple, Microsoft, and Google over the last 90 days.
Tesla stock price last month
Compare TSLA and AAPL normalized returns YTD
How is the market doing?
Compare some tech stocks
Show me the S&P 500 this year
MSFT vs AAPL last 5 years
Facebook's total return over the past 2 years
Compare Apple and its performance since last quarter
cases.note: 'last quarter' is not in the supported timeframe vocabulary -- the system should ask for clarification rather than guess a date range.

cases.prompt: since 2024-05-10 how has NVDA done
Compare AAPL and MSFT
cases.note: No timeframe given at all -- the system should ask for clarification rather than assume a default range.

cases.prompt: Compare Coca-Cola and Pepsi over the last year
cases.note: KNOWN LIMITATION CASE: the offline mock LLM only recognizes a fixed set of ~13 company names and will fail this one (see README 'Known Limitations'). Included deliberately so the eval set is not tuned to 100% -- a real LLM provider (LLM_PROVIDER=openai/anthropic) would be expected to pass it.
